extraType.text: This file already serves `{{firstTypeName}}`, and `{{typeName}}` is a second type with methods in it. When each file serves one type, its name is an index: a reader looking for `{{typeName}}` opens the file named for it and finds its declaration and its methods together, and a change to one type never scrolls past another. Move what this file holds of `{{typeName}}` into a file that serves it alone. A type's methods may still be split by theme across files, as long as each file serves that one type.
